Between us, we’ve built a lot of cool hardware (cameras for autonomous drones, AR/MR headsets) and cool software (ML for satellites, AI for the shipping industry).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83256&key=user_uploads/914508/f65f0c3b-ceef-4c41-b76f-0ded74c39615)

### The Problem

As a former hardware engineer, Shan experienced the challenges of managing complex projects across a network of vendors, suppliers, and manufacturers. He saw hardware teams struggle to use traditional project management solutions with vendors because of the unstructured nature of projects and communications, security and access issues, and difficulties in the adoption of new processes. The workflow inevitably defaulted to emails, text messages, WeChat, etc., often leading to misplacement of crucial information.

A 2021 report revealed that 70% of engineers still use email for external collaboration, struggling to track critical information across teams. 94% of engineers want faster access to data, and 29% often work with outdated information, leading to costly delays, reworks, and longer time to market.

We’re building Vendra to change that.

### The Solution

**Vendra uses AI to bring a smart project management suite and file repository to hardware teams working with vendors and suppliers - all with no change to existing workflows.**

Simply connect Vendra to your email/WeChat/WhatsApp/Slack (or cc it to your conversations and threads):

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83256&key=user_uploads/914508/0497419e-34ee-4f22-8f08-e15331533c4c)

Vendra automatically contextualizes your emails/messages/files and generates key takeaways like project and conversation summaries, open items, blockers, tasks, etc. It also creates a smart file directory so you never have to go digging through emails or attachments ever again.

Easily access all this information from anywhere through our SlackBot, GPT-like chat interface, or web-based dashboard:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83256&key=user_uploads/914508/ad310c5b-4582-4e07-9e43-1bbaf6691b37)

You can ask Vendra AI things like

* ‘Show me all the quotes and lead times we got from vendors for the upper bracket machining in the past month’
* ‘What are all the open items for the enclosure injection molding tooling?’
* ‘Pull up the RF module datasheet the supplier sent me last week’
* And so much more!

For teams looking for 2-way external collaboration, we also offer VendraPM - a secure end-to-end platform to onboard your vendors and work together across projects and tasks. Features like secure file sharing, document revision control, and AI-enabled language translation make external work easier than ever:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83256&key=user_uploads/914508/850d8b2a-133f-492b-a346-3f441932ab20)

### The Ask

* If you work in hardware, [book a demo today!](https://calendly.com/vendra-shan/30-minute-vendra-chat)
* We also love warm intros to folks in hardware - if you know anyone working in (or around) hardware, we’d love to chat with them to understand their workflow and see how we can help!

launches.body:
Ciao Y Combinator! We’re [Davide](https://x.com/davideasnaghi) and [Lenny](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lennykhazan/) from [Diode Computers, Inc.](https://diode.computer/)

**TL;DR: Diode is an end-to-end platform for circuit board design. With the help of AI, we can finish a months-long design project in days, and then ship working boards straight to your door.**

**Try out our designer at **[**https://pcb.new/**](https://pcb.new/)**, or shop generated boards at **[**https://pcb.store/**](https://pcb.store/)**.**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aOoG2gl8wdY>

# Problem

Designing printed circuit boards (PCBs) is really hard. Existing tools provide little opportunity for design reuse, so most projects are started from scratch. Since there’s no good way to test your design, your best bet is to just order them and hope for the best.

Thought you were done? Nope — ordering PCBs is a pain too. Now you need to source the components, ship them across the globe to your manufacturer, and constantly be on the lookout for part shortages and replacements. It’s a full-time job.

# Solution

Diode solves this by owning the entire PCB design process end-to-end. It starts with a core of composable, reusable modules that users can stitch together to build their boards. When new use cases come up, our AI generator creates new modules in seconds instead of days. And with rigorously-tested modules instead of de novo designs, we can be confident that each board works first try.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83244&key=user_uploads/79914/00e25ff4-abe8-49d4-94c3-e74a925eb0a3)

We then take the user’s design and automatically translate it into manufacturing requirements to send to the factory. We stockpile all of the necessary components to remove the burden of supply chain management from users and amortize the cost of parts across all designs.

The result is an all-in-one platform for hardware design: describe what you need and get working boards delivered to your door.

# Why

In a past life, we designed hardware at companies like Apple, and we encountered a problem: PCBs never worked on the first try. At best, they required micro-soldering surgery under a microscope and, at worst, a whole new board. These issues were driving us mad, so we started a company to fix it.

We want to make hardware design work more like software. Fast iteration cycles, reusable components with clean composition, and one-click ordering to build your products fast and cheap. Our vision is to turn PCB design into a software problem.

**P.S.** Want a customized NFC business card with your logo? Get your own: <https://pcb.store/products/nfc-business-card>

launches.title: Steinmetz - Hardware for the Next Generation of Vehicles
launches.tagline: Steinmetz, the engine of electric vehicles
launches.body:
Hey YC,

We are Ethan and Owen, building the engine of electric vehicles. Motor controllers with 3x higher power densities, that remain cost competitive with existing solutions.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uIQkUCxhIG4>

# The Problem

Automotive manufacturers are quickly transitioning to electric vehicles but initial offerings remain expensive and are largely unprofitable. This has led to slow adoption compared to their combustion engine counterparts.

We have both witnessed while working at Tesla, the immense difference in design and cost between Tesla's vehicles, and EVs from existing vehicle manufacturers. Incumbent part suppliers and manufacturers are skilled in the intricate mechanical design of combustion engine vehicles, but lack the electrical expertise for EVs which are primarily chips and PCBs.

# Our Solution

At Steinmetz, we are starting with the inverter (motor controller). This lies between the battery of the vehicle and the motor--it converts the DC power from the battery into 3 phase AC for the motor. Using modern power electronics techniques and tight systems integration, we are able to deliver a motor controller which achieves 3x greater density than the state of the art, at equal or greater efficiency. This allows us to bring down not only the unit cost of inverters in vehicles today but, through greater density and higher efficiencies, the cost and performance of the whole vehicle.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88019&key=user_uploads/1381592/997953eb-7e3b-4ba7-9d07-6a1d21f3c43f)

To give context for the density improvements here, our bandgap product is able to drive a peak power of 200kW through the equivalent volume of 3 yerba mate cans. This is the same power draw as 450x 4090 GPUs or 6.5 server racks fully populated with H100 GPUs (208 GPUs).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88019&key=user_uploads/1381592/981f5792-0f6b-42c9-bb4a-dee43a2c8e2b)

# We are on a mission to simplify electric vehicle hardware and accelerate adoption

If you are working on any electric vehicle (trains, cars, boats, snowmobiles, cranes, submarines, planes, tractors, etc.) learn more at [steinmetzmotors.com](https://steinmetzmotors.com/) or send us an email: [founders@steinmetzmotors.com](mailto:founders@steinmetzmotors.com)

We’re building an AI Analyst for Electricity Markets, starting with the owners of grid-connected battery projects.\
\
<https://www.loom.com/share/8b4a7f0bbe5042679f28bb1c6c498c01?sid=2e96b889-041b-4c50-aea1-dabaaa7fecef>

**Context**

Battery owners earn revenue by charging (buying) and discharging (selling) power in electricity markets.

The goal is to maximize revenue within constraints – some of which are physical, like battery capacity, duration, and efficiency, while others are regulatory. This is challenging because (1) markets are volatile and (2) complex and frequent regulatory updates make it difficult to assess both the revenue impact of rule changes and compliance risks.

**Problem**

To make money on the grid, battery owners must analyze market data and keep up with thousands of constantly changing regulatory documents. Electricity markets work like auctions -- every 5 minutes, battery owners decide how much power to buy or sell and at what price. Even the most data-savvy teams can’t keep up, leaving owners with little visibility into how others are making money. And rule changes aren’t just small tweaks – they can completely upend the market. To avoid financial penalties, battery owners spend millions on lawyers and consultants just to stay compliant.

**Solution**

Dartboard is an AI Analyst that uncovers missed revenue for owners of grid connected batteries while ensuring compliance. We provide value in two key ways:

* **Market Intelligence:** We ingest historical market data so that owners can evaluate optimization strategies and uncover money they might be leaving on the table.
* **Regulatory Guidance:** Our AI Analyst, trained on the latest rule changes, translates complex regulations into clear, actionable insights — helping owners navigate compliance without the need for expensive consultants.

**Asks**

If you know any developer/owner/operators of grid-scale battery projects, energy traders, or energy-focused private equity investors, we’d love to meet them. Please reach out at [**rohun@dartboardenergy.com**](mailto:rohun@dartboardenergy.com).

launches.title: Inversion Semiconductor – Scaling Chips to their Physical Limits
launches.tagline: Manufacturing the most powerful chips 15x faster
launches.body:
# Scaling Chips to their Physical Limits

Imagine a chip fabrication machine that produces the most powerful chips 15x faster.

Seven months ago, Rohan was automating chip design at Arm while finishing his master’s in Mechanical Engineering at Imperial College London. Meanwhile, Daniel was creating novel ML models for stability optimization of tabletop particle accelerators at CERN. All while completing his master’s in Applied Physics at University College London.

We realized that we could build a novel lithography machine, to truly kill Moore’s Law. And we could do this by shrinking particle accelerators 1000x, to build a high power light source driven by laser wakefield acceleration (LWFA). 

Here’s a concept video of how our lithography machine will work:

<https://youtu.be/kNx7mCVQ304>

# Background

Lithography is the process of using light to pattern circuit features on silicon. It’s the most important step in making chips. 

With a monopoly on advanced lithography machines, ASML produces 13.5 nm “EUV” light by blasting tin droplets and directing the light on to a wafer using mirrors. However, advanced chips constantly demand finer circuit features. To improve resolution, ASML enlarges its mirrors, a trade-off that significantly increases system complexity and cost.

Over the next decade ASML targets 1 kW of EUV light out, with 1 MW of power in. We aim to achieve 10 kW of even shorter-wavelength light. This will also enable our light source to power multiple lithography machines, unlocking billions in annual revenue gains for fabs.

# Currently

We aim to generate the required high power light using “tabletop” particle accelerators capable of accelerating electrons to extremely high energies over centimeters, rather than the kilometers needed for large accelerators at CERN and SLAC. We’ll do this using plasma waves (wakefields) driven by a high power laser. 

So far we have:

* Set-up a mini laser lab in the basement of the YC office, to test our novel laser stability algorithms
* Developed initial LWFA prototypes to generate small-wavelength light.

We’ve secured a strategic partnership with the world’s leading research group for LWFA development – Lawrence Berkeley National Lab and the Berkeley Laser Lab Accelerator (BELLA). Our collaboration, dubbed the Laser Undulator eXperiment (LUX) or BELLA-LUX (Beautiful Light), is initially focused on improving laser stability and testing light generation using our prototypes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87848&key=user_uploads/1787486/4977528a-59c0-47a9-944f-0cf3211ffa2c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87848&key=user_uploads/1787486/757f3d74-9e83-4864-bd8b-6d105de5d7a5)

# Next Steps

During the BELLA-LUX collaboration, we aim to build a high power, tunable light source – STARLIGHT. We are currently exploring early applications to accelerate technical development towards lithography. Companies like Tesla and Applied Materials are interested in potential applications for industrial x-ray imaging and semiconductor mask inspection.

Our goal is to generate 1 kW of soft x-ray light (20nm – 6 nm). If successful, this milestone will pave the way for a user facility, where booking beam time will be as simple as reserving a SpaceX launch—using your credit card. 

Simultaneously, we will develop novel mirror systems to reflect and focus generated x-ray light. This will allow us to demonstrate silicon patterning with our initial LITH-0 system, powered by STARLIGHT.

# Asks

If you know incredible plasma / particle accelerator scientists or lithography engineers, we’d love an introduction.

Intros to VPs / C-Suite at semiconductor manufacturing companies

Got spare laser system parts (optics, gratings, actuators etc)? We’ll take them.

launches.tagline: Pickle joins Zoom calls on your behalf and makes you look great.
launches.body:
# **tl;dr**

Pickle replaces your Zoom camera with a virtual body double that always looks great—even if you're calling in from bed.

# **Why we’re doing this**

Daniel attended 10‑hour Zoom classes daily when he was a medical school student. He experienced extreme Zoom fatigue and discovered that it wasn’t just because he hated listening to boring medicine lectures—it also caused [neurophysiological](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-023-45374-y) problems. We imagined there must be [countless people](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zoom-video-commn-encryption-idUSKBN22C1T4/) suffering from the same issue, desperate to escape the Zoom prison.

<https://youtu.be/cCdZX6hxJpI?si=f3RCtpSQiquAbmCs>

# **Who’s using Pickle?**

Since launching Pickle last October, we’ve interviewed over 400 Picklers worldwide. What surprised us was that not only were people experiencing Zoom fatigue from back-to-back meetings, but even those **who wouldn’t turn on their camera** for a single call were using Pickle.

Engineer moms who have to care for their kids, new employees with severe anxiety disorder, and CEOs who want to look professional no matter where they are—all these people found Pickle essential for their daily work. We realized that Pickle isn’t just a vitamin—**it’s a painkiller**.

# **The lowest latency human model**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87621&key=user_uploads/2376609/95f16234-6efd-417b-880f-b00310ccbdbd)

We developed an ultra-fast human model that processes voice input and generates output in **under 0.3 seconds**. This enables a user’s Pickle to lip-sync almost simultaneously with what they say. Moreover, as our user base grows, our model rapidly upgrades thanks to the influx of data.

# **Live together & work 24/7 in Hillsborough**

[Daniel Park](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielpkl/) - a medical school dropout who built a $2M/year e-commerce business at age 22 while still in medical school

[Emmett Kim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emmettpkl/) - a CS dropout and a super-generalist in product, design, and engineering, who is also the star of [our viral demo](https://x.com/getpickleai/status/1859284410136465671)

[Sam Yu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sampkl/) -  our CTO; a summa cum laude CS & EE dropout who built a self‑driving AI model at just 21, is a believer in reinforcement learning, and met Emmett in high school

[Sanio Jung](https://www.linkedin.com/in/saniopkl/) - a former medical doctor and self-taught engineer who developed an AI model for detecting wrist fractures and met Daniel in college

[Chris Kang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrispkl/) - a CS dropout and social media expert who created and managed an account that achieved over 100 million views

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87621&key=user_uploads/2376609/459c0987-33d6-4621-9329-c3ff18d68f0b)

# **Our Ask**

Get your own [Pickle](https://getpickle.ai/)!

launches.title: Axal - Automate identifying and fixing architectural tech debt
launches.tagline: Break down monoliths, identify tech debt, and fix it with AI at scale!
launches.body:
Hey everyone, I’m Nand - Founder at Axal👋\
\
We built a tool that uses deterministic methods to **automate the hardest parts of application modernization**— identifying architectural bottlenecks and prioritizing those issues based on business value. Once the issues are broken down by Axal, AI can autonomously collaborate with your team to resolve them.

# **The Problem**

Everyone knows that software teams cut corners in development over time, resulting in accumulation of debt tech overtime that slows them down and raises costs. Until now, to address this problem there needed to be long modernization efforts, where stakeholders spent months finding possible solutions to the problem, if you could even find and train the team members needed to do the work. 

# **Our Solution: One platform for Application Modernization**

Axal uses deterministic methods to provide teams with clear observability into architectural technical debt.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/5453ac1a-0928-4ba2-91f1-665ad2c142fd)

We show tech debt scores tailored to your goals. For example, if maintainability is your focus, we display the maintainability index, aligning business impact with priorities to guide effective action.

Technical teams can leverage our graphs to gain clear insights into class-level and domain-level codebase relationships.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/ceaeb77c-b33c-4ef2-8540-3e5fc5f564d2)

Architectural issues - domain exclusivity, circular dependencies, dead code, etc. - are automatically detected based on the goals that an organization makes, and engineers can work with Axal to assign their priority.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/f63d172c-c479-4a22-92b6-ab40ffdd2ef7)

Once prioritized, **Axal leverages AI to autonomously address issues**, while ensuring none of the existing code breaks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/01d79606-ac19-4fd4-a503-aff34a23a9c8)

**Demo Video** (\* excludes technical debt scores and AI code fix demonstration)

<https://youtu.be/4WAwWXrpAGU>

# **Our Ask**

Please reach out:

\- If you want to see your team's architectural technical debt 

\- If you have a Java, C#, or Go monolithic application you want to modernize, contact us (min. 100k lines of code)

Please let us know if you have any previous connections to large to medium-sized companies undergoing application modernization

Learn more at [axal.ai](http://axal.ai)

Hey YC!

We’re [Jennifer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jennifer-y-song) and [Adam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-mhatre-5b8aaa230/) - cofounders of Photonium.

**TL;DR**

Photonium automates optical system design with AI, replacing costly manual iteration with end-to-end system optimization.

**🚨 The Problem**

Optical systems are mission-critical across many high-growth sectors — including quantum technology, biomedical imaging, LiDAR for defense and autonomous vehicles, and metrology for semiconductor fabrication.

But designing them is a nightmare:

* Companies pour millions into teams of 20+ optical engineers
* Projects take months or years to go from R&D to production
* Tools are fragmented and outdated
* Optimization is manual and often based on trial-and-error

Engineers spend countless hours on repetitive workflows — constrained by tools that haven’t changed in decades.

**⚙️ Our Solution**

Photonium is building the electronic design automation (semiconductor EDA) for optics. We work with complex optical setups across industries and handle the entire design process — from system generation and optimization to simulation, tolerancing, and sourcing.

Photonium enables companies to:

* Generate and optimize designs from product specs
* Predict tolerance impacts without slow simulations
* Recommend data-driven alignment and manufacturing tweaks
* Optimize for cost, size, and performance trade-offs
* Seamlessly integrate with existing CAD workflows and optics simulation tools
* Automate the full design-to-sourcing pipeline

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/YvX3Xr2_Gt8)

**🚀 The Team**

Jennifer studied physics, math, and CS at Harvard and built quantum optics experiments across Harvard, Stanford, and QuEra (a Google-backed quantum computing startup).

Adam studied computational physics at Stanford, and worked on plasma simulation for fusion and large-scale astrophysical modeling of black holes.

We’ve both felt the pain of inefficient engineering design firsthand — and built Photonium to fix it.

⚛️ **Why This Matters**

Optical systems are foundational to cutting-edge technologies, from quantum computing to semiconductor fabrication. Yet, outdated tools and fragmented workflows slow innovation and inflate costs. We hope to eliminate these bottlenecks and accelerate innovation across industries.

launches.title: NODI Energy - Distributed Energy Infrastructure to Rewire the Grid
launches.tagline: Making the grid flexible to unlock GW power, enabling on-grid interconnection for data centers
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋! We're [Borong](https://uk.linkedin.com/in/boronghu) and [Catherine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cathjeong/), co-founders of NODI Energy!

**TL; DR:**

NODI is building distributed energy infrastructure to rewire the grid. We are deploying and aggregating batteries at the edge. All these distributed nodes are orchestrated to make the existing rigid grid more flexible, reducing grid congestion and unlocking more capacity at specific constrained locations. So data centers can get **_on-grid_** connection in weeks instead of waiting on grid reinforcement for decades. ⚡ ️ **Gigawatts unlockable on the way!**

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/svScryhDnog>

### **Problem**

The existing power grid was built for the fossil-fuel era, not for tomorrow’s economy. It’s too rigid to deliver power to the right place at the right time.

* 2,000 GW of projects, including data centers, sit stalled in grid connection queues, waiting up to 15 years.
* 200 TWh of renewable energy was curtailed last year, with several countries dumping over 20% of their generation.
* Over 1,000 GW of capacity could potentially be unlocked from the existing network, only if the grid is flexible enough.

### **Solution**

We are building a vertically integrated engine to create a flexible grid. Three layers: 

* **Hardware:** originating from the edge, we deploy our own plug-in batteries and aggregate energy assets from third parties.
* **Software:** orchestrating and operating as these distributed nodes to enable real-time locational flexibility in the grid.
* **Intelligence:** modeling the grid from edge data, reducing grid congestion, and delivering capacity at the right time and place.

### **It’s giving main character energy**🌟

Results in 6 months:

* 2,000 plug-in batteries on the way, per month!
* Onboarding >1 GW of batteries in 2026.
* Secured a pipeline to aggregate 10 GW of assets in 2027.
* Soon to be one of the largest multinational VPPs.

### **Team**

Borong Hu, PhD in power electronics from Warwick and postdoc at Cambridge University, with 60+ papers, IEEE awards, and government grant funding. Built power conversion systems for AI data centers and one of the world's largest offshore wind turbines. Led R&D collaborations with world-leading industrial partners.

Catherine Jeong, Second-time industrial tech founder with a decade of experience across energy, climate investment, and policy. Holds a BA in Political Science from Brown University and an MSc in Climate Innovation from London School of Economics. Former NCAA Division I fencer, now taking a stab at the grid.

launches.title: PowerMatrix: Efficient and Compact Power Supply for AI Hardware
launches.tagline: Efficient and compact power supply for GPU and data centers to save 50% energy
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

PowerMatrix delivers highly efficient and compact power supplies for cutting-edge applications—from GPUs and data centers to drones, EVs, and aerospace. Based on proprietary technologies, our power supply systems can reduce energy loss by up to 50%. We’ve built working prototypes and are piloting with world-leading partners.

# **The Problem**

AI computing heavily relies on data centers where every watt of electricity is processed and converted by multiple stages of power supplies—from the power grid to processors.

Currently power supply solutions face significant challenges:

* **Inefficiency:** Data centers consume 5% - 10% of global electricity, while 20% of that (100TWh) is wasted on power supplies.
* **Size Constraints:** Power supply is given very limited space in server trays and on GPU board surface but required to provide much higher power.
* **Performance Gaps:** It is required to provide a voltage conversion ratio over 100 and provide 1A/ns dynamics for robust operation of future advanced AI computing processors.

# Our Solution

Based on proprietary technologies, we provide the reverlutionary **single-stage vertical power delivery solution:**

* **Single Stage:** directly convert high voltage to <1V low voltage, eliminating inefficiencies multiple stage power conversion chains.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90889&key=user_uploads/2116203/943302c9-5ff6-4189-8cd3-47d80cd3b6d0)

* **Vertical Power Delivery:** minimize power transfer loop, locating directly underneath computing chips.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90889&key=user_uploads/2116203/a4ce171d-72bb-4bfe-b640-23d7eb2db1d6)


Results vs. incumbents:

* **80%** smaller form factor
* **50%** less energy wasted
* **10×** faster dynamic response

Deploying our modules can save customers **$10 B** annually, cut **30 TWh** of electricity waste, and avoid **100 Mt** of CO₂ emissions each year.

# Team

We have more than ten years of experience in power electronics and are dedicated to solve the most challenging tasks in this area.

Borong did a Postdoc at the University of Cambridge and got his PhD in power electronics from the University of Warwick. He has extensive experience in research: he published 60 papers that got 650 citations and received the IEEE ECCE William Portnoy Award. He also worked on a power converter for the largest wind turbine at GE, and led a team at Bitmain, a bitcoin miner, to develop a new power supply.

Xufu got his PhD in power electronics from the University of Cambridge. He received the Semikron Danfoss Young Engineer Award in 2025, the Trinity Bradfield Prize Award in 2025, and First Place Award of the IEEE ECCE Best Student Project Demonstration in 2023. He also published 15 papers on power electronics that have 41 citations.

# Our Ask

If you’re building AI hardware, data-center infrastructure, or next-gen power-electronics, let’s connect! [info@pwrmatrix.com](mailto:info@pwrmatrix.com)

Hello!

We are [Hans](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kumarhans) and [Hardik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hardiksingh) - longtime friends and co-founders of Boost Robotics.

**TL;DR**

Boost Robotics builds autonomous mobile manipulation robots that can inspect and physically interact with data center infrastructure.

Instead of dispatching technicians for every cable check, reboot, or hardware swap, data centers can now triage and resolve issues through “robot remote hands”. When not performing interventions, the robots continuously provide 24/7 security monitoring and operational analytics.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SVqbUd1crU0

🚨 **The Problem**

As AI infrastructure continues to scale up, data center physical operations are becoming increasingly difficult:

* **Growth bottleneck:** AI demand is scaling faster than the operational capacity to support it.
* **Increasingly Remote Locations:** Data centers are being built near cheaper power sources in sparsely populated areas—often with limited access to skilled labor.
* **Competition:** Hyperscalers are looking for every possible edge. Downtime means SLA violations and lost revenue.
* **Hazardous Environments:** Maintenance involves high-voltage power and toxic liquid coolants.

Now more than ever, robots are gaining the dexterity and generality to solve these critical problems.

🤖 **The Solution**

We are building a general purpose robot to handle a variety of use cases in data centers. 

* Predict, find, and solve issues faster, even when you’re not physically on-site. 
* Enable one skilled technician to debug multiple issues across multiple sites through context-aware teleoperation, and eventually autonomy.
* Provide 24/7 security monitoring and inventory management, simplifying compliance and financial audits while collecting data for your data center digital twin models.

launches.title: Cascade Space - Deep space communications as a service
launches.tagline: Your next lunar mission just got easier!
launches.body:
# tl;dr

Cascade Space is building a turn-key communications system for lunar and deep space missions. Our ground station network and integrated software tools work together to maximize uptime and availability, while reducing spacecraft iteration cycles from weeks to hours. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/7b3a56ce-8dc0-48db-a2e5-3badb2afd893)

**Why are we building this and why now?**

The Deep Space Network (DSN), NASA’s global network of ground terminals for communicating with deep space probes, is [oversubscribed by 40% and in desperate need of upgrades.](https://newspaceeconomy.ca/2024/09/02/nasas-deep-space-network-challenges-and-the-road-ahead/) The DSN is all but unavailable for most commercial operations. Companies with missions going to the Moon and beyond have to deal with a patchwork of individual dish operators for every mission, each with bespoke hardware, specs, and interfaces. Furthermore, many of these commercial providers are not able to handle the demand and [operational failures also can lead to loss of mission](https://www.astroforge.com/updates-collection/odint-mission-debrief).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/c6aa8968-e567-42e5-8866-866414630f22)

**Comms system design is fraught with peril**

The spacecraft comms system design is tightly coupled to the available ground network. Engineers spend hundreds of hours poring over datasheets, on the phone with vendors and suppliers, and endless email threads, only to put all this data into a giant spreadsheet to make sense of it. Every iteration requires not only painful attention to detail, but also in-depth esoteric knowledge of how radio frequency systems and channel coding schemes work in order to accurately predict in-flight performance. Simple misunderstandings can lead to catastrophic errors in design and configuration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/1623d16f-4789-4793-892f-2c7adffc84a7)

**End-to-end comms system validation often doesn’t happen**

Fully integrated testing between the spacecraft and ground terminal is typically cost prohibitive. Instead, engineers compare spec sheets and email configurations to the ground operators, and hope it works in flight (spoiler alert: it often doesn’t). It is routine for spacecraft to fly having never done an end-to-end test of their system with ground terminal representative hardware. The whole process is subject to human error from end to end. 

**This approach to space communications does not scale**

Commercial space ventures beyond low earth orbit have already pushed existing infrastructure to its breaking point, and demand for deep space comms support is expected to grow exponentially over the next decade. We will not have a spacefaring future for humanity until communications for spacecraft become as easy as signing up for cable internet. 

**We are redefining the process, starting with spacecraft design**

Better comms starts at the beginning, in the early trade study and design phase. We are replacing industry-standard spreadsheets with a modern software tool that lets you see how your system will perform with our ground network in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/4873c5a0-9288-48fe-8d2e-a3a32f3fcad0)

**Test as you fly, fly as you test**

You don’t rise to the level of your expectations, you fall to the level of your testing. We ship you a “ground station in a box,” identical to hardware we’ve installed at the ground stations you will be using, and provide you with a test plan that you can use to test your entire system end to end, with both the space vehicle and the ground terminal in the loop. 

**Launch with confidence**

Fly and operate your spacecraft. Use our API to schedule passes on our network, track your spacecraft, stream data, monitor the ground site, and access recordings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90423&key=user_uploads/222992/2b01ca98-b6d7-4f8b-9af5-5b93b0613ef0)

**We are rolling out our preliminary network rapidly**

We start by partnering with owners of dishes that are currently unused for any other telemetry applications. This allows us to build out the product and acquire customers with a minimal amount of capital. As we build out the network, we will further expand our network by strategically building our own ground stations in key locations. Our first downlink only ground stations are expected to come online in 2025, with more to follow in 2026.

**We are passionate about your mission success**

[Jacob](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30556) and [Arlen](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2222230) have solved many of these exact problems at company level scales in previous roles. Jacob was RF system architect at SpaceX and Arlen has built complex hardware/software systems his entire career. Collectively they have spent hundreds of hours in mission control, many of those hours dealing with anomalies and outright failures. They are both passionate about building the culture of excellence at Cascade that is required for flawless mission execution.

**If you are struggling with comms for your upcoming mission, drop us a line. We can help.**

https://cascade.space/

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Engineers and scientists rely on simulations and physical testing to understand how the world works. Today, those tools are slow, expensive, and fragmented. 

Running a single simulation can take hours to days. Building physical prototypes takes weeks to months. Every domain—from fluid dynamics to thermal modeling—requires different solvers, different experts, and perfect setups. This creates massive bottlenecks in innovation.  We’re building AI that turns engineering questions into instant, physics-based models. No solvers. No bottlenecks.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
The next wave of breakthroughs will come from AI that deeply understands physics, not just text.

We’re building Godela to give humanity the power to instantly model, explore, and invent across the physical world. Imagine being able to instantly test any idea, uncover hidden relationships, and accelerate discovery at the speed of thought.

**AI powered physics is the next frontier**

**TL;DR:** Godela is an AI-powered physics engine that gives engineers faster, cheaper, simulation-quality answers to even the most complicated engineering problems.

Hi YC—we’re @Cinnamon Sipper and @Abhijit Pamarty, former engineers at Apple, Google, and Intel, now turning our Stanford research into the future of engineering.

https://youtu.be/I5E1Zi9cpM4

**The Problem: Engineering Discovery is Too Slow.** Every groundbreaking innovation—from fusion reactors to life-saving drugs—hinges on understanding how the physical world works. Yet, engineers spend agonizing weeks, even months, wrestling with complex simulations, preprocessing data, and manually tuning parameters just to answer _one_ question. Many critical questions go unasked because the effort is too great.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90799&key=user_uploads/1725296/03894dba-703c-4a25-a00b-b1ba24b27392)

**Our Vision: Ask About the Physical World as Easily as You Use Language.** Imagine a world where understanding the implications of a new design, material, or physical scenario is as instant as a search query. That’s the future Godela is building.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90799&key=user_uploads/1725296/b7ae00e6-d8ea-4354-a110-233a65568e0f)

**Introducing Godela: Your AI Copilot for Engineering.** Godela is an AI-native platform that transforms your engineering questions into computable, physics-informed models—instantly.

* **Ask Anything:** Pose complex questions in natural language or with your existing data.
* **Upload Your World:** Integrate CAD files, experimental results, or existing simulation data.
* **Get Instant Insights:** Receive actionable, simulation-quality models you can explore, refine, and iterate on immediately.

Instead of replacing simulations, Godela becomes their intelligent, adaptive home—blending diverse data sources with AI to provide insights that were previously out of reach or would take weeks to uncover.

**Why We’re Building This:** As engineers who’ve designed everything from chips and laptops to particle accelerators, we’ve lived the frustration of slow design-simulation loops. Inspired by how AI revolutionized access to information (like ChatGPT for language), we believe it’s time for the same leap in understanding the physical world.

name: OS3
long_description:
OS3 is building the platform that makes intelligent robots accessible to every business.

Today, robotics is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: hardware is too expensive to deploy at scale, and robots are difficult to train because high-quality robotics data is scarce and costly to collect. 

We built OS3 to solve both.

Our two-person team designed and a US-made mobile humanoid robot for a fraction of the cost of commercial alternatives. On the intelligence side, instead of relying on expensive robot-generated training data, we trained our own video-action model on 150,000 hours of real-world video spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Every deployed robot feeds new experience into our reinforcement learning pipeline, self improving robot fleet over time.

This creates a robot that can be deployed across industries to automate repetitive, physical work without requiring a new robot or training pipeline for every task. Our robots are already deployed in hotels, with customers now expanding the platform into biotech, hospitals, and data centers, including a wet lab at Stanford.

Our mission is to do for robotics what Apple did for personal computing: take technology that was once expensive, specialized, and inaccessible and make it powerful and usable at massive scale. We’re building toward a world with billions of intelligent robots, and OS3 is the platform that makes that possible.

**TL;DR: OS3 is building semi-humanoid robots for physical labor. Our first robot, H.A.L.E 1.0, is built for everyday human tasks, and our first model is based on 2,000+ distinct real-world tasks and 150,000 hours of video data. We are opening up pre-orders to all with shipments starting this Fall.**

**Physical AI Problem:**

A lot of teams and businesses want to build and deploy in the robotics space. But they have to source parts or buy hardware from different vendors. Furthermore, the recent import ban makes it even harder for beginners and startups to use the latest hardware, unless they are willing to spend tens of thousands of dollars. Post hardware, constant data collection is needed to adapt open or closed-source models to the ever changing hardware choices. In other words, everyone keeps reinventing the same wheel of modern robotics development over and over again.

[**Video Link**](https://youtu.be/dDwaQbZYPLQ)

We built OS3: Both the hardware from ground up and the model to control the hardware. Our first robot, H.A.L.E. 1.0 (Human Aligned Life Enhancing), is designed to handle a wide range of everyday physical tasks, and we are presenting the prototype unit today.

The intelligence layer is a two system architecture, with a high level planner layer and a lower level execution layer. The model has been trained on 150,000 hours of video data spanning over 2,000 real world tasks. Technical report coming soon, once evaluation runs finish. name: F4 Industries
long_description:
GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. 

Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix.

That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.

Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds.

When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem.

After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team.

And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.

launches.title: F4 - Automated compliance checks for engineering drawings
launches.tagline: We help hardware teams 10x how they redline & interpret engineering drawings
launches.body:
# **What is F4 in a nutshell?**

We’re helping hardware-rich teams 10x how they redline and interpret engineering GD&T drawings. With backgrounds at Tesla and SpaceX, we’re building a platform that finally treats drawings like code—automatically validating every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards so noncompliance is caught instantly.

https://youtu.be/SYzqZ4XWmCA

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/a6d6c66e-7e58-4405-b4e2-48c30b354495)

# **The Problem & Why We Built F4**

Drawing literacy is one of the weakest skills across hardware teams. Yet drawings are made every day.

These aren’t just illustrations—they’re effectively business contracts between designers and manufacturers, defining what’s acceptable in production. Drawings carry the bulk of design intent—fit, form, function, and fabrication—and act as the important source of truth across production, quality, and supply chain.

GD&T standards from ASME and ISO exist to formalize this communication. But they’re dense and confusing. Across major revision years, there are thousands of pages of definitions, edge cases, and revision quirks. Designers are expected to know it all, leads are expected to catch every mistake, and suppliers are expected to interpret drawings flawlessly. One mistake means scrap, delays, or worse.

# **Our Solution**

Why is something so critical still so manual? Why can’t drawings be validated and interpreted more quickly and robustly —like code? Why can’t hardware dev be more like software dev?

We’re changing exactly that!

F4 treats drawings like code—they either execute or fail immediately. Our platform checks every dimension, tolerance, and GD&T symbol against standards in real-time, ensuring full compliance before a drawing ever reaches the floor. No more total reliance on manual redlining and reviews.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/1aa5904c-3086-4722-8838-ffda9c0d7a85)

F4 ensures engineers never release noncompliant drawings—and suppliers never misinterpret them. F4 helps industrial teams eliminate costly scrap, rework, and miscommunication at the root.

# **How It Works**

1. Upload a drawing (dxf…and very soon pdf)
2. Select GD&T standard of choice (ASME Y14.5 - 1994, 2009, & 2018)
3. Get instant compliance score graded against a desired GD&T standard using **deterministic logic**
4. Get recommendation to correct any asset (FCF, FOS, datum, basic, modifier, and/or dimension) of the drawing that is noncompliant with references to ground-truth sources
5. With a compliant drawing - get standard definition, inspection plan, and tolerance analysis interpretations on any drawing asset of interest

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93123&key=user_uploads/2642473/accc67da-db20-423d-84b0-7ec4904ad800)

## **Hardware Platform Built by Hardware Engineers!**

I worked at Tesla as a Mechanical Design Engineer and took 6 parts from clean sheet design to production for the CyberCab and SEMI drive system programs. I was also the lead engineer for Tesla’s global drive unit heat exchanger program with +3 million unit annual production volume.

Aidan worked at SpaceX as an Avionics Test Engineer, where he designed and owned testing hardware (PCB boards and testing apparatus) for the Raptor 3 Engine - the most advanced rocket engine in the world. 

In college, we led The University of Alabama’s Rocket Team where we achieved the university’s first-ever liquid rocket engine hotfire! I built the rocket engine and Aidan built the electrical/software for our propulsion system.

https://youtube.com/shorts/rBwsqu_sdeg?si=RgRU_eqib7_-qLcV

## **Ready to Ditch Manual Redlining?**

If you're tired of pretending to be good at GD&T:

_SigmanticAI_. What it can do:

* **Natural language to synthesizable Verilog + testbenches**

* Built-in **onboarding**, codebase **annotation**, and **spec** documentation **generation**
* LLM-powered on both **cloud** and **fully air-gapped/on-prem** deployments

We’ve already made a RISCV CPU start to finish with it, onboarded our first paying customer, and are getting 90%+ accuracy on the VerilogEval benchmark (NVIDIA framework)

launches.title: Introducing the Blue Smart Dictation Keyboard for iPhone
launches.tagline: 4x faster when you can speak, normal keyboard when you can't
launches.body:
Blue's dictation is unlike anything you've ever tried before. Instead of transcribing what you say, we give ChatGPT the audio and we ask it: "Based on what this person said, what do you think they would have typed if they had a chance to review and edit?"

That means you can think out loud, repeat yourself, change your mind mid-sentence, and Blue still hands you something that’s ready to send. Check it out: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ED3e1ODMH3g>

So what happens when dictation finally becomes reliable? Not just better dictation for the 1% of the time your hands are tied up and you have to dictate. You start _defaulting_ to dictation every single time you have to type, and you end up saving a ton of time!

Get it right now: heyblue.com/download

Hey everyone, we’re [**Bruno**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bruno-finco-610999b6/) and [**Girish**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/girish-radhakrishnan/), founders of [**MOVEdot**](https://www.movedot.ai/).

# TL;DR

* When developing any sort of hardware, engineers are the bottleneck due to data/information overload, creating huge inefficiencies and waste
* We built a Cursor-like interface that allows humans and AI agents to work together on multi-modal data, achieving 10-100x efficiency
* We started with race cars and are now expanding to other industries
* [**Book a demo**](https://www.movedot.ai/) or email us ([founders@movedot.com](mailto:founders@movedot.com))

https://youtu.be/tA-4cdiJ5tI

# ❌ The Problem

Every engineer says the same thing:

> “Too much data, not enough time.”

Data collection has grown 10x, but the **same human brain** still has to make sense of it. Engineers spend days digging through spreadsheets and KPIs to find what failed. Or more realistically, they give up, leaving most data unused.

# ⚙️ The Solution

We built **MOVEdot**, an AI agent platform that allows you to use 10x more data to make decisions. It connects to data, video, and test standards, automating reports or answering questions like:

> _When did temperature spikes cause mechanical failures, and what were early signs?_

Agents process the data and produce interactive dashboards and mind maps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95237&key=user_uploads/1931404/3f0d742e-35f8-4d25-8c7a-ccd153474570)

Physical-world testing is a **$250B market** across development, durability, and validation. Our goal: give every engineering team **thousands of AI teammates** that helps them use **100%** of their data, increasing performance and shortening time to market. From racing to robotics. From proving grounds to production lines.

# 🏎️ Race Cars - Why We Started Here

We began in motorsports: time-sensitive environment with short sales cycles. Closed our first 30k deal within 2 weeks of the POC. Well, we were also race car engineers…

Hey everyone! This is [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benjamin--rubin/) and [Yining](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yining-z/) from [Norra](https://www.linkedin.com/company/norra-io/), the AI equipment operations platform for nursing facilities.

TL;DR: Norra uses AI and real-time tracking to give nursing facilities operational intelligence they've never had.

🚨**The problem:**

Nursing facilities are facing an existential crisis. With the aging population, demand is surging but they can't keep up. Medicare cuts coupled with inefficient operations mean that over 50% of facilities lose money and are struggling to keep their doors open, all while facing a massive impending staff shortage.

Facilities run blindly with zero operational intelligence. They’re scrambling to manage equipment lifecycles, discovering things are broken too late (leading to failed audits), and over-purchasing because they don’t know what they have. This operational chaos costs each facility over $100K and 1,000 hours of staff time per year, time that could be spent caring for patients.

💡**The solution:**

<https://youtu.be/dI02IH5izfk>

With custom hardwares, Norra creates a digital twin of their entire facility, giving staff complete visibility into everything happening on the ground. With all of this data, we are able to use AI to transform the operational chaos into proactive decision making. Instead of reacting to equipment going into disrepair or overpurchasing equipment due to lack of visibility, staff now get actionable insights to prevent waste before it happens.

What it actually means: Preventative maintenance reminders and tracking, Intelligent and automated purchasing workflows, Insights to improve utilization and cut costs

**⚡Impact:** \
\
We've cut our first facilities' rental spend by 70% and projected to save them $100K+ this year.

**👥 About Us:**

Ben and Yining met two years ago at NASA building astronaut operation software. They are two roommates turned cofounders passionate about using AI to make a real impact in healthcare. 

Ben has spent 1000+ hours in hospitals and nursing facilities seeing first hand how broken their operations are.\

launches.tagline: Robotic Factories that Build Robots
launches.body:
Robotic factories building robots. Today we have a 12,000 sqft factory in the Bay Area manufacturing everything from full humanoids to robots for the International Space Station.

Our thesis: Revitalizing domestic manufacturing means driving costs down through automation. We are building an autonomous factory that is able to autonomously process a new order end to end from prototyping to large batch production. That means supply chain management, design for manufacturing, industrial machine retooling, robotic adaptation, quality inspection, packaging, and logistics all automated. Goal: Create a factory that can autonomously go from placed customer order to completed unit scale manufacturing run in 24 hours.

We are currently manufacturing production runs from top labs, full humanoids, and even have a partnership to manufacture robotics for the International Space Station. We've also built supply chain relationships in electronics, actuators, SMT, computing, pneumatics, and raw material suppliers.

A snippet of some of our machines in the factory:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/777065e0-e83d-4501-8799-8c490e883851)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/30775e59-e171-4949-b959-3dc06ffa5322)

## **Manufacturing at the Core**

This isn't just a robotic manipulation company. Its a manufacturing company.

Internally we have pipelines autonomous building large databases of actuators, and raw tracking and trying to predict what items will need to order now to meet our next day targets.

## **The Harness**

The entire factory is a data harness we can "backprop" learnings through from errors in the customer designs, failed supply chain prediction, slow retoolings, to inaccurate robotic manipulation. Our core belief is that robotic machine learning should not rely on human data to scale but instead learn to improve from its own mistakes in the real world in real time. This closes the manufacturing data gap that currently limits large-scale factory automation.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/2baf7c74-80e3-49bb-a6bf-712ce0fb30fc)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/4ed0acb3-e1bc-4210-b4d0-b3f3614bc8da)

## **Any Robot Anywhere**

Our thesis is simple. We should be able to make an robot for any environment whether that be a humanoid for the factory floor or a robot for Low Earth Orbit. We currently have a partnership with the ISS to manufacture a robots for the space station.

NASA Houston, Johnson Space Center

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/e4558cfa-cf98-447a-acaf-7e83650e73a7)

## **Team**

At heart we're a team of Roboticists. Before Tensr we were the leads for a Berkeley lab's autonomous racing team where we raced autonomous full-scale IndyCars at over 160mph as the ML, Sim, and Robotic Controls leads.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112228&key=user_uploads/2763027/c3772faa-f515-4ee0-b32e-2e586b3ae8e3)

We previously worked in industrial automation, aerospace manufacturing, medical device manufacturing, Berkeley AI Research (BAIR), physics simulation, and secured $17M+ in DARPA / industry sponsorship for UC Berkeley / Stanford research.

Our founding engineers range from Berkeley Robotics PhD, ex-NASA, to 10+ years of manufacturing experience.

## A Better World

On a personal note, not only do I believe we have the opportunity to build a great business but also to make a positive impact on the world. Automate away environmentally harmful materials, eliminate waste 0.1% at a time, and drive steady-state COGS toward only the fundamental inputs (materials and electricity), unlocking strong margins while collapsing the price of everyday goods / cost of living.

Lets build a better world :)

A full view of our vision here:[ tensr.com/whitepaper](https://www.tensr.com/whitepaper)

launches.title: Tensr: Building Autonomous Robotic Factories
launches.tagline: Building fully autonomous robotic factories that make scaling hardware as effortless as scaling on AWS
launches.body:
We're building fully autonomous robotics factories at Tensr to create the AWS of manufacturing. Our factories will receive on-demand orders from customers and spin up robots to operate industrial machinery, package, and ship the finished product all in 24 hours.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95506&key=user_uploads/2763027/704a7eb3-1ffc-4fc3-b806-32f3fd256418)

[**https://youtu.be/HLijIfoDfpA**](https://youtu.be/HLijIfoDfpA)

**Problem**

Moving fast in manufacturing today doesn't exist. Iterating designs for manufacturing takes months of back and forth getting samples from China and pre-ordering manufacturing capacity several months before the holiday rush, only then to wait several weeks for shipping praying there isn't a strike at the docks. At the same time we see the complete collapse of America industrial capacity as American workers and experience leave the field and contracts are sent overseas.

**Solution**

With the robotics revolution, for the first time it is possible to fully reimagine the factory floor - moving from rigid lines to modular stations, even in high mix settings. However, we believe that automating manufacturing is more than just deploying a foundation model or a humanoid into an existing factory.

Factories need to be designed from the ground up _around_ robots, not the other way around.

Over the past few weeks we turned our living room into an autonomous factory floor, with stations for CNC, moving stock, and a focus on assembly. After demo day, we'll expand to a full manufacturing facility, and start supporting batch orders of all sizes from other companies throughout the country. Currently we also are in talks to provide our own assembly models to other distributors.

launches.title: Frontier Computing – Growing biological brains at scale
launches.tagline: We colocate memory with compute in biological tissue, so you can train larger models at lower cost
launches.body:
TL;DR – We're deploying exascale biocomputing clusters, growing biological systems with memory baked into compute at the substrate level, enabling training of models at parameter counts that would otherwise be inaccessible under traditional GPU architecture-constrained approaches.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112791&key=user_uploads/2627752/445c283b-feb2-4b6b-9d2c-ab2cf60edc7d)

Hey all, we're Frontier Computing, and we’re excited to announce that we are growing the first large-scale neuronal tissues for ML training and inference!

Frontier is launching its 500M biological neurone cluster by January 2027, which will be 2500x larger than the next-largest publicly available system in the biocomputing space that companies are currently restricted to building on. \
\
We'll continue to launch increasingly larger iterations of our substrate to circumvent the challenges of GPU parallelisation seen in roofline analysis across computation/computation/memory, colocating memory with compute in biological neurones to circumvent the infra problem of GPU networking for model training and inference, enabling inference time training at scale on biocompute, at much lower cost than traditional GPU approaches.

# **❌** The Problem

Biological brain tissue is already being bought and sold, including being trained for a range of tasks from gaming environments to next-token prediction, but the scaling limits of the underlying wetware have acted a fundamental barrier to useful economic output.

Academia has previously been unable to exceed a \~1M neurone scale due to "the vascularisation problem", where neurones cannot grow past a geometric limit imposed by insufficient oxygen access in cells that are increasingly far away from active supply.

# **✨** Our solution

Frontier has developed a novel neuronal tissue culture approach to engineer large-scale brain systems that exceed traditional scaling limits of neuronal tissue culture.

This enables us to scale past traditional wetware substrate sizes, supporting much larger biological neural nets with correspondingly greater parameter counts, increasing the complexity of task environments these systems can represent, and using their larger geometric size to provide physically larger surfaces for I/O and informationally rich encode and decode.

We provide the substrate, interfacing and cloud infrastructure to enable third parties to train on our systems, taking advantage of the inference-time training capacities of biological neurones, the sample efficiency, the capacity to exist in an abstraction layer above backprop, and the opportunity to perform RL on models in excess of sizes that would be traditionally accessible on GPU hardware due to memory bandwidth issues that we circumvent through colocating memory and compute within neuronal tissues.

## **🏆** What we've achieved so far

\- We have proven out the first scalable culture system for biocompute, and demonstrated its computational capacities by training our system to play the arcade game Frogger

\- Demonstrated tail-end capabilities in sample efficiency, with 1 hour of real-time learning producing 92% peak cross rate (over a 25-game sample) in our Frogger environment

\- Raised a 10M pre-seed round to produce early scale up our team and wetlab work, led by General Catalyst with participation from LocalGlobe, Amino Collective, Kaya, Long Journey Ventures, Off Piste Capital, SVA and more angels and firms that we are very excited to have on board

\- Begun build out of a 100M and a 500M biological neurone system, live EOY 2026

## **🔜** What's next

\- Demonstrating SOTA task performance of biohybrid models using our larger-scale substrates

\- Launching our API library to enable our customers to implement their own models and RL environments via our platform

\- Iterating towards post-neocortex-scale build outs to further enhance computational capacities of biocompute

## **👥** Our Team

[Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-domarkas/), CEO, is a Cambridge Natural Scientist who first learnt programming at 8 through C# Unity game development, competed in maths/chess/bio competitions nationally throughout high school, and has been culturing neuronal tissues for the past two years, starting from $20K USD in grant funding at 17 from Emergent Ventures. He has built the first scalable neuronal culture platform for biocomputation and validated performance via reinforcement learning on this substrate.

## **🙏** Asks

Join the team! We're hiring across the stack for neurobiologists, RL researchers, electrical engineers, and biochemists, accepting both direct applications and referrals. Feel free to get in touch at the link below:

<https://frontier.site/careers>

If you're interested in working at the _frontier_ of biocomputing and scaling the fundamental wetware primitives humanity has access to, Frontier Computing is building out the leading platform in the space. We’re looking forward to collaborating with you.

launches.body:
TLDR We’re eradicating mosquitoes (700k people killed each year) with micro-drones.

Hey YC!

[Clovis Piedallu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/clovispiedallu/) and [Alex Toussaint](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-toussaint-51a439189/) are building [Tornyol](https://tornyol.com/), **a micro-drone that kills mosquitoes**. We use smartphone microphones, car park assist sensors and some clever DSP and control to transform 40-gram toy drones into mosquito killers. Because these drones are so cheap and fast, we could lower the cost of mosquito control by 100x to enable the eradication of malaria.

Our upcoming product is a micro-drone + base station that patrols your garden 24/7 and eliminates any mosquito in the zone. After a few days of action, you’ll notice that you can enjoy mosquito-free evenings and dinners. Enjoy a mosquito-free life for just $50/month (if you save your spot **right now for just $100**)!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dDa9pFzeJvE

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95287&key=user_uploads/1250342/2697e87e-51cb-405e-bf8b-e4446880f4cc)

# How it started

Alex has been passionate about ultrasonic sonars for a while, building [one of the first air-gapped ultrasonic phased array sonars.](https://www.alextoussaint.com/2021-04-28_How-I-built-an-ultrasonic-3d-scanner.html) Alex then worked at MBDA Systems, supplier of UK-FR missiles where he did outstanding work in navigation and control. That’s when long-time friend [@Clovis Piedallu](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2515354) and him had the (at first) stupid idea of building mosquito-killing drones. After proving from napkin math that this could lead to mosquito eradication, we got a $28k grant from [Scott Alexander, Vitalik Buterin](https://manifund.org/projects/build-anti-mosqu) and [some big twitter buzz.](https://x.com/alextoussss/status/1778460625196261863) Since, we’ve made enormous strides in the field including the first detection and tracking of a mosquito with an ultrasonic phased array, plus some fancy algorithms which are detailed more [here](https://hackaday.com/2025/03/25/supercon-2024-killing-mosquitoes-with-freaking-drones-and-sonar). We’ve made a lot of progress since in the control department, but can’t share much more without nuking an ongoing patent. The TLDR of that is **we believe we can eradicate mosquitoes from a square kilometer of land with just 10 40-grams drones, slashing the cost of mosquito control by 100x**

# The tech, with a few more details

We send an ultrasonic pulse using a regular ultrasonic transmitter (the one you can find in the HC-SR04 arduino modules, or on cark park assist sensors) then listen for the echoes using an array of smartphone microphones. This phased array of smartphone microphone allows us to get a directional recording of all echoes in the scene. To classify the echoes, we plot a spectrogram of the echoes as a function of time. Whenever a mosquito beats its wings, the movement produces irregular doppler effect. By measuring that alternating doppler effect, we get a 2D image that’s unique to each mosquito. We then detect the species and sex of the target we have in front of us. Here’s what these signatures look like.

**Wasp (phase, STFT, FFT)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95287&key=user_uploads/1250342/e34717d5-91b3-435f-b7b3-33eacfa00d77)

**Mosquito (phase, STFT, FFT)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95287&key=user_uploads/1250342/21bf0588-a122-48c8-9a62-60426d8e7b94)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95287&key=user_uploads/1250342/8bb71855-e1f9-4ea0-922f-06da6690c1c5)

Our phased array sonar (Xilinx XC7A100T and 380 PDM Microphones). We’ve miniaturized it since.

Then, by using some very clever control algorithms, we ram our autonomous tinywhoop into the mosquitoes and away from the walls.

# Our current development status

Most systems are working in isolation, and we’re doing a push to have them all working together. Our miniaturized DSP+Controls processor is currently in the PCB factory, and all algorithms have been tested either on separate benches or in simulation. We’re currently killing mosquitoes in simulation, and are working hard to kill them in the real world.

# Asks

Mosquitoes are a terrible problem worldwide **700k people killed each year, 700M catching a mosquito-borne disease and 4 billion people at risk of Dengue**.

We’re looking for early adopters for who mosquitoes are a big nuisance to proof-test our first drones when they work before we deploy them to areas where failure’s not an option. If that sounds like you, please pre-order and enjoy all the perks (limited edition color, 30% discount) that come from our small $100 refundable reservation.

# CTA

[tornyol.com](http://tornyol.com): $100 refundable deposit to get exclusive, early and discounted acess to our solution.

[founders@tornyol.com](mailto:founders@tornyol.com):\_for any contacts to big businesses, government entities and NGOs who could be clients.

Looking forward to your questions!

[Clovis Piedallu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/clovispiedallu/) and [Alex Toussaint](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-toussaint-51a439189/) for a mosquito-free world.

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95161&key=user_uploads/187048/b726300c-0e1d-4190-87ac-44a8bc4a2ed3)

Greetings dear humans – we’re building **Lightberry: the social brain for robots.**

We work with manufacturers like Unitree and Booster to make robots listen, speak, and act. You can program your robot out of the box by literally talking to it, no coding involved.

Robots running Lightberry are:

* emotionally intelligent
* always on
* fully autonomous

Just like in Star Wars!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aJZ3pcFyfg4

### **Why?**

We’ve seen robots on stage: folding laundry, serving popcorn, doing backflips… But before robots get deployed in homes, offices, and shops, they need to become good at **interacting with people**.

Slapping ChatGPT realtime on it is not enough, every manufacturer tried that already. It responds to every little noise, lacks personality, and needs to be teleoperated.

Lightberry makes robots **contextually aware**, **customizable**, and **autonomous**.

_We’ll let our robot Mini-Pi say it in its words:_

[**https://youtu.be/e1gD57WY74s**](https://youtu.be/e1gD57WY74s**)

### **Is it just a voice pipeline on top of a robot?**

No. Lightberry robots have agency. They **decide** when they want to speak or move. Our robots can **see the world** around them, **navigate it** without hitting obstacles, and have an internal **monologue of thoughts**.

_Here’s our robot Koko’s hot-take:_

[**https://youtu.be/Y7SN58Cdvs4**](https://youtu.be/Y7SN58Cdvs4**)

### **What can your robots do?**

Robots running Lightberry are being deployed to interact with people: homes, offices, shops, conferences, etc. Our software works on many different robots: Unitree G1, Fourier GR-2/N1, Booster T1/K1, High Torque Mini-Pi/Mini-Pi+ …

_Here are a few robots we’ve deployed Lightberry on – meet Koko, Synthia, Alfred, Blake, Minnie, and Bradford:_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95161&key=user_uploads/187048/60dd09f1-41ed-488c-bb73-546727f5d606)

### **Ask**

**We want to deploy as many robots in the real world as possible.** If you want to:

* Hire a robot for a people-facing gig (conference, sales, marketing, receptionist, concierge…)
* Integrate Lightberry into your robot (if you’re building hardware!)

**Please email us at [founders@lightberry.com](mailto:founders@lightberry.com).**

Thanks,

[**@Ali Attar**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/255747) & [**@Stephan Koenigstorfer**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/187048)

launches.title: Piris Labs: Inference at Light Speed
launches.tagline: We deliver low-latency, low-cost AI inference by eliminating the memory wall using full-stack optical interconnects and a purpose-built software stack.
launches.body:
**The Problem: The Memory Wall Is Breaking the Economics of AI Compute**

AI’s promise is unprecedented, but its economics are broken. Copper-based interconnects cannot keep up with modern models, limiting data movement between and within compute and memory. The result is high latency, inefficient hardware utilization, and unsustainable inference costs—creating a hard ceiling on AI margins.

---

**The Solution: Grow-Style Optimization for the Interconnect**

Today’s data-center compute and networking were not designed for inference. Slow, power-hungry **copper** interconnects, along with costly signal processing and memory overhead, drive high latency and high cost.

High-performance inference requires purpose-built hardware and a vertically optimized software stack. Piris Labs builds this optimized stack by combining proprietary **optical** interconnects with software designed to maximize hardware utilization. We vertically optimize the interconnect layer—just as the compute layer was vertically optimized by **Groq** (acquired by **NVIDIA** for $20 B).

Piris Labs combines proprietary optical interconnects with a purpose-built software stack designed to maximize hardware utilization, delivering **5x** lower latency, **10x** lower power per bit, and **2x** lower cost per token\
\
**Our Launch Video**\
<https://youtu.be/PW1PbMYw2c0>

**The Team**

We are a team of specialists at the intersection of hardware and AI:

* Ali Khalatpour: MIT-trained engineer and Harvard–Stanford–trained optical scientist; developed the first room-temperature terahertz semiconductor laser; led the development of GUSTO’s optical engine for NASA
* Keyvan Rezaei Moghadam: AI scientist and engineering leader with experience building 0-to-1 AI infrastructure at Meta and Twitter.

### **Our Ask**

**AI Products**: If you want to scale your inference workloads while slashing costs, reach out to us at [**contact@pirislabs.io**](mailto:contact@pirislabs.io).\
\
**Chip Makers & ODM Partners**: We are also looking for a couple of additional partners who get the chance of trying our optical solution first hand. Shoot us an email at [**founders@pirislabs.io**](mailto:founders@pirislabs.io).

launches.title: Seeing Systems: Modular Autonomous Drones for Modern Warfare
launches.tagline: We build modular, autonomous strike drones that adapt as warfare evolves.
launches.body:
# **Hey everyone**

We’re Alex & Matthew - The brothers building **Seeing Systems**.

---

## **TL;DR**

We're building **inexpensive, autonomous strike drones** designed to stay operationally relevant as warfare evolves. By combining true hardware modularity with an agentic control system that lowers cognitive load on operators, we enable faster upgrades, broader adoption, and more than 2x reduction in lifecycle cost.

Our customers and partners include the UK Royal Marine Commandos, several other units in the UK, and 4 other NATO forces, and we are currently shipping prototypes to Ukraine for iterative feedback.

<https://youtu.be/Ia_A1T-l7d8>

## **Problem**

Military forces face two linked challenges:

1. **Platform Obsolescence:** Fixed drones require replacement or major rebuilds whenever missions or threats evolve, driving high costs and slowing operational adaptation.
2. **The One Pilot Problem:** One person can only control one drone at once, requiring full attention.

Countless stories can be found of western drone systems becoming obsolete, needing to be shelved and eventually replaced.

A Few Examples:

* <https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/ukraine-s-military-rejects-german-helsing-1768811354.html>
* <https://militarnyi.com/en/news/ssu-abandons-altius-attack-drones-after-failures-at-front/>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97412&key=user_uploads/2822007/9dfb1275-b59e-4c17-9862-3a9d8a11534d)

# **Solution**

We build autonomous, modular drones that solve both problems at once:

* **Modular hardware:** Swappable payloads, sensors, compute, and comms let one platform support strike, ISR, or swarm missions. Upgradable and effective year after year.
* **Agentic autonomy:** Automates tasks like navigation and coordination, so operators with no prior training can use systems to their full effectiveness.

How do we know? Well, Forward Deployed Engineers. Giving each unit we work with a point of contact, we take feedback and integrate them into our system in a matter of hours. A close collaboration with the UK Royal Marines Commandos is actually what led to the development of this system.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97412&key=user_uploads/2822007/7170ca7a-bd1d-4d2b-a6a7-f77ce762975e)

## **The Team**

**Matthew Le Maitre - Co-Founder, Software**

Former Jane Street Software Engineer and top-ranked CS graduate from the University of Cambridge. Matthew’s path started at the Mobile Robotics Lab at Cambridge, where he worked on autonomous systems and context-aware drones. He now leads the software side of Seeing Systems.

**Alex Le Maitre - Co-Founder, Hardware**

Alex has been obsessed with unmanned systems since childhood and is largely self-taught in embedded electronics, firmware, and PCB design. He has previously designed Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) training and diagnostic hardware for military users, alongside projects with national-security implications. Originally from the island of Guernsey, Alex now leads hardware development with a focus on building robust systems that help keep our people safe.
